name: opencode-agent-prime
description: AGENT-PRIME orchestration plugin for OpenCode — lessons RSI, plan mode, memory MCP, specialist delegation

scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external zod
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external zod
scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:cli && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && npm run generate-schema
